description: Within each group, average supplied log2 values across cells; all sections pooled.
Rank the 86 available GO-category genes within each mean profile; average ranks for ties.
Compute four Spearman correlations with tD1; contrast delta=rho(tD1,A)-rho(tD1,B).
Independently resample whole cells with replacement within each group, retaining its original size; reuse the SAME tD1 sample for all four correlations in each replicate.
Recompute means, ranks, correlations and all six contrasts in each replicate.
Report unadjusted p primarily; Holm-adjusted p also provided for the family of six comparisons.
Cell-exchangeability assumption; conditional on fixed imputed values. Spatial dependence and imputation uncertainty are not propagated. Not animal-level inference.
